text: ここ　＊で　＊などを　＊ひき　ボールを　なげまくって　つかまえた！

structure.jp: ボールを　なげまくって

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck onto a verb stem means doing it over and over, wildly and without stopping. なげまくって = 'throwing like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: なげまくって　つかまえた
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, here showing how the catching got done. なげまくって　つかまえた = 'threw and threw and caught them'.
